title: What lives on the memory board, and in what shape?
context: The board is the long-term memory every agent reads: it is what lets an orchestrator retire and a new one pick up without loss. Crux's .decisions folder already does this for decisions (JSON records, a status lifecycle, superseded instead of deleted, readable summaries). The question is how far to widen it.

options.name: Decisions plus free memos
options.summary: Keep .decisions as it is and add a memos folder of plain Markdown notes (handoffs, requirements, how-to-work-here).
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='20' y='30' width='130' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='85' y='87' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Decisions</text><text x='85' y='101' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>(typed)</text><rect x='170' y='30' width='130' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='235' y='87' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Memos</text><text x='235' y='101' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>(free text)</text></svg>
cons: Requirements and handoffs have no lifecycle, so they rot silently
Hard to build an index or interface on free text

options.name: Typed entries, one lifecycle
options.summary: Every entry is a JSON record with a type (decision, requirement, convention, memo, thread), a status lifecycle like decisions have, links between entries, and a one-line summary for the index.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='15' y='25' width='92' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='61' y='49' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Requirement</text><rect x='114' y='25' width='92' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='49' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Decision</text><rect x='213' y='25' width='92' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='259' y='49' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Convention</text><rect x='15' y='120' width='92' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='61' y='144' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Memo</text><rect x='114' y='120' width='92' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='160' y='144' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Thread</text><line x1='61' y1='65' x2='150' y2='118' stroke='currentColor' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><polygon points='150,118 143.0,117.4 146.1,112.2' fill='currentColor'/><line x1='160' y1='65' x2='160' y2='118' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='160,118 157.0,111.7 163.0,111.7' fill='currentColor'/><line x1='259' y1='65' x2='170' y2='118' stroke='currentColor' stroke-dasharray='4 3'/><polygon points='170,118 173.9,112.2 177.0,117.4' fill='currentColor'/><text x='255' y='145' font-size='11' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>same record shape</text></svg>
pros: Everything can be superseded, parked or retired the same way
One index and one interface for all of it
Decisions can point at the requirements they serve
cons: A schema to design and keep stable
Agents must write structured entries, not just notes

options.name: Living topic pages
options.summary: A small wiki per project: one page per topic (architecture, data model, requirements) that agents keep editing, with decisions linked from them.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='20' y='30' width='85' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='62.5' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Architecture</text><rect x='117' y='30' width='85' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='159.5' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Data model</text><rect x='214' y='30' width='85' height='120' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='256.5' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Requirements</text></svg>
pros: Compact: one page per topic, not hundreds of entries
cons: Several agents editing one page collide

criteria.name: Builds on Crux as it is

recommendation: It is the Crux record widened to every kind of memory: one shape, one lifecycle, one index, and the nothing-is-deleted rule extends to requirements and handoffs for free.

settles.value: typed JSON entries (decision, requirement, convention, memo, thread) sharing the Crux status lifecycle; superseded, never deleted
